text:
deploy-bot: Starting rollout v3.12.0 -> prod. Change window 2026-03-20 02:00-03:00 UTC. Preflight checks: all green. Deploy staged to 20% of traffic.

sara (oncall): Watching SLOs now. I'll call immediate rollback if p95 > 350ms for 3 consecutive 1m buckets or 5xx > 0.5%.

miguel (eng-runtime): Noted. KV cache behavior changed in this build — watch tail latency and cache-miss rate.

john (eng-releases): Pin for emergency rollback is v3.11.5; policy reminder: pin + stop-rollout if triggers hit.

leah (eng-sre): I'm tailing traces and the edge latency panel. Region fallback ready if needed.

monitoring-bot: [02:10:14 UTC] ALERT: error_rate_api_prod >= 0.7% (1m avg) — firing on-call policy.

sara (oncall): seeing the spike on the SLO dashboard. p95 jumped to ~420ms in the last minute. Initiating rollback checks.

miguel (eng-runtime): rolling back canary cohort now. Executing traffic shift for canary groups -> v3.11.5.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by miguel at 02:10:45 UTC. Status: rollback in progress. Traffic for v3.12.0 shifting 20% -> 0%.

john (eng-releases): Noting in release tracker: rollout aborted due to increased latency/error rate. Will add a short note to release notes and block re-rollout until root cause.

sara (oncall): Postmortem ticket INF-3491 created for follow-up. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

miguel (eng-runtime): quick logs show cache-miss spike around the same time. Snippet:
```
[02:10:12] cache.miss rate +4.2x vs baseline
[02:10:13] backend latency +3.6x
```

leah (eng-sre): Adding a temporary mitigation to the runbook: add KV warming and reduce eviction aggressiveness for next patch.

monitoring-bot: [02:12:03 UTC] RESOLVED: error_rate_api_prod back to baseline (0.08%) after rollback.

sara (oncall): Closing this thread — change window ended early. Follow-ups: add KV stress case to preflight, update rollout checklist to include a 5m tail-latency watch for KV-sensitive builds. :white_check_mark:
